text:
Isolated for eons, Sol’Kesh is an island without humanity, without a species to 
spark flame and conquer. A primal landscape of predator and prey, clawing at 
the edge of extinction, where a single law of life reigns supreme, evolve or die 
Competition breeds adaptation and an immense variety of life has taken root and 
flourished. From miles of exposed coral reefs, sunken forests and fungi-lit caves that 
riddle the earth below. Wild and unique flora and fauna struggle in an evolutionary arms 
race, fighting for their next breath, their next meal and for their next generation to survive
Welcome to Sol’Kesh, The Speculative Evolution Bestiary
There will come soft rains and the smell of the ground, 
And swallows circling with their shimmering sound; 
 
And frogs in the pools singing at night, 
And wild plum trees in tremulous white; 
 
Robins will wear their feathery fire, 
Whistling their whims on a low fence-wire; 
 
And not one will know of the war, not one 
Will care at last when it is done. 
 
Not one would mind, neither bird nor tree, 
If mankind perished utterly; 
 
And Spring herself, when she woke at dawn 
Would scarcely know that we were gone.
Sara Teasdale
1884 – 1933
Chris McLeod (Order #50397132)
